mutations.because: The defect this lane fixes, restored: both report files are written in place again, with no temp sibling and no rename, so a write that is still in flight is a truncated file a concurrent reader parses. The torn-read test lands half a payload and reads it back mid-write; under the direct write that half file IS the target and JSON.parse fails, which is the 13-of-200 unreadable reports the plan measured. Re-anchored 2026-09-24: PT-0a moved the report's file handling from report.ts into ports/fs-report-store.ts (ReportStorePort); the mutation is unchanged in meaning.

A staging write that fails before its temp exists leaves nothing to unlink; without the swallow, the cleanup's ENOENT replaces the real failure and the caller is told the wrong thing. The disk-full test asserts the original error surfaces. Re-anchored 2026-09-24: PT-0a moved the report's file handling from report.ts into ports/fs-report-store.ts (ReportStorePort); the mutation is unchanged in meaning.

Only the latest pointer is written in place again while the per-campaign report stays atomic. A reader of report.json can then parse a torn file; the rename-targeting test asserts both destinations are staged, so it fails.
